comment: getline.c hooked_tty_getlin(): the recorder sends each moves character up to U+00FF as one byte, so 'ö' and 'é' arrive as 0xF6 and 0xE9. Each passes the ' ' <= (unsigned char) c test and is stored; putsyms() echoes it through topl_putsym(), which advances the cursor while recorder patch 006's nomux_putch() leaves the cell untouched for a signed high byte. The erase key removes 0xF6, so the engraving holds N E9; ':' reads it back, and the space dismisses the staircase message's --More--.
